- Real-time inference for VLA is defined as 10 to 100 ms of latency (10 Hz to 100 Hz).

- Software optimizations: CUDA graph and operator fusion can reduce latency.
- Hardware: NVIDIA Jetson Thor is mentioned as having up to 128 GB memory, sufficient for complete VLA models.
- Deployment options: On-device (edge GPUs), edge servers, or cloud.
